issue_headline: Margins of Error and Managerial Despair
issue_deck: Week 2 brings a razor-thin thriller, a 57-point clubbing, and benches full of regrets.

lead_story.headline: A Nail-Biter and a Megawatt Blowout Define Week 2 Chaos
body: Fantasy football continues its tradition of offering zero middle ground, splitting Week 2 between heart-stopping decimals and absolute industrial-grade blowouts. While most of the league found various ways to mismanage their Sundays, ThreatLevelMidnight and Voldemort engaged in a knife-fight that ended in a 0.9-point margin, good for the narrowest win of the week.

At the opposite end of human dignity stood Malle ❤️ 🐸, who flattened Uncle Rico by a staggering 57.96 points. It was a stark reminder that while some managers spend their weekends sweating every single yard, others simply prefer to build a 138.16-point fortress and watch the rubble smoke.

matchup_recaps.headline: A 0.9-Point Heart Stopper
matchup_recaps.body: History entering the week showed a dead-even 5-5-0 series between these two, and they refused to break the script until the final whistle. ThreatLevelMidnight squeezed out a 132.88 to 131.98 victory, surviving a monster 38.0-point outing from Voldemort's Jaxon Smith-Njigba by managing a pristine 100% lineup efficiency.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Fortunate Escape in the Meadowlands
matchup_recaps.body: Joe Mantegna collected a 107.32 to 96.42 win despite leaving points on the table. The Big Gronkowski will be staring into the middle distance wondering how a roster featuring CeeDee Lamb's 31.3 points managed to slide backward.

matchup_recaps.headline: Josh Allen Does the Heavy Lifting
matchup_recaps.body: Patty Primetimes cruised to a 113.82 to 99.78 victory, fueled almost entirely by Josh Allen's astronomical 46.82-point explosion. Post Mahomes countered with Patrick Mahomes's respectable 34.98 points, but it wasn't enough to bridge the gap.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Routine Separation
matchup_recaps.body: Pop Lockett Drop it kept their momentum rolling with a clean 113.88 to 97.86 win over Buttermilk Puuump. Dak Prescott tried to drag Buttermilk Puuump across the finish line with 37.76 points, but the rest of the lineup hit a collective speed bump.

matchup_recaps.headline: Goff Guides the Way
matchup_recaps.body: malle_dips_pouches handed Ginger FC 🏆🏆 a 124.58 to 103.82 defeat, snapping Ginger FC's four-game winning streak in the process. Jared Goff orchestrated the attack with 37.78 points, rendering Justin Jefferson's efforts for Ginger FC a footnote.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Historic Shellacking
matchup_recaps.body: Entering the week 9-2-0 historically against Uncle Rico, Malle ❤️ 🐸 decided to pad the stats in the most violent way possible. Piling up a league-high 138.16 points against Uncle Rico's meager 80.2, Malle ❤️ 🐸 turned this historic rivalry into a public service announcement.

managerial_desk.headline: The Weekly Bench Autopsy: Leaving Wins in the Locker Room
managerial_desk.body: Uncle Rico endured the most agonizing Sunday in the league, leaving 36.98 points on the bench while posting an optimal score of 117.18 against a pathetic actual output of 80.2. Starting Lamar Jackson, Jonathon Brooks, and Colston Loveland while letting Matthew Stafford, Kyle Monangai, and Terrance Ferguson outscore them from the pine is a masterclass in how not to play fantasy football. Meanwhile, The Big Gronkowski wasn't far behind, wasting 32.38 optimal points by benching Jordan Love, Xavier Worthy, Tank Bigsby, and Bhayshul Tuten.

luck_report.headline: Brutal Beats and Underved Escapes
luck_report.body: Voldemort earned the week's most agonizing badge of dishonor, absorbing a brutal bad beat with 131.98 points—the third-highest score of the slate—only to run straight into ThreatLevelMidnight's buzzsaw. Voldemort boasts an 81.82% expected win rate and an 9-2 all-play record, proving that the fantasy gods simply harbor a personal vendetta. On the flip side, Joe Mantegna scraped together a lucky win, posting the seventh-best score of the week (107.32) while managing a meager 5-6 all-play record.

players_of_the_week.headline: Individual Brilliance Amid Managerial Ruin
players_of_the_week.body: Josh Allen put the entire league on his back for Patty Primetimes, dropping a slate-best 46.82 points. He was joined in the winner's circle of individual performers by Jaxon Smith-Njigba (38.0 points for Voldemort) and Jared Goff (37.78 points for malle_dips_pouches). On the ground, Jonathan Taylor paced all running backs with 27.2 points for Uncle Rico, while Travis Kelce led tight ends with 20.6 points for Malle ❤️ 🐸.

record_book.headline: Streaks Snap and Rivalries Burn
record_book.body: Ginger FC 🏆🏆 saw their four-game winning streak evaporate at the hands of malle_dips_pouches, while Malle ❤️ 🐸 successfully snapped a two-game losing skid by demolishing Uncle Rico. ThreatLevelMidnight and Voldemort flirted with history, finishing just 0.84 points away from the all-time narrowest win record of 0.06.

next_week.headline: Week 3 Previews: History Collides With Projections

previews.headline: Historical Dead Heat Meets Model Expectations
previews.body: History shows these two locked in a dead-even 5-5-0 all-time series with 986.32 points for The Big Gronkowski and 1058.48 for Ginger FC 🏆🏆. Yahoo projects Ginger FC 🏆🏆 to edge this one out with 113.35 points to 101.7.

previews.headline: Chasing the Historical Deficit
previews.body: malle_dips_pouches holds a 7-4-0 historical edge in 11 prior meetings against Malle ❤️ 🐸. The projection model likes malle_dips_pouches to build on that momentum, sitting at 118.51 compared to Malle ❤️ 🐸's 90.21.

previews.headline: A Slim Edge in a Tight History
previews.body: Voldemort enters with a 6-5-0 historical advantage across 11 games. Yahoo projects Voldemort to take care of business at 109.09 to Joe Mantegna's 99.42.

previews.headline: Defending Past Precedent
previews.body: ThreatLevelMidnight holds a 2-1-0 historical lead over Buttermilk Puuump. The projections have Buttermilk Puuump narrowly favored at 105.14 against ThreatLevelMidnight's 100.21.

previews.headline: Overcoming the Series Ledger
previews.body: Historically, Patty Primetimes leads the head-to-head 5-3-0. Despite the past history, Yahoo projects Pop Lockett Drop it to lead the charge with 117.05 points to 111.62.

previews.headline: A Lopsided History Seeks Resolution
previews.body: Post Mahomes commands a comfortable 6-2-0 historical lead over Uncle Rico. The projection model favors Post Mahomes again at 107.33 over Uncle Rico's 92.16.

closing_shot: If your lineup efficiency starts with a 6, do everyone a favor and let a random generator pick your starters next week.
